summary: This report provides an update to members of the General Government Committee on the status of the overall state of amenities of Nathan Phillips Square, the on-going repair program and future planned capital works (both funded and unfunded), the combination of which forms the holistic State-of-Good-Repair program.
decided: The General Government Committee: 1. Requested the General Manager, Economic Development and Culture, in consultation with the Chief Financial Officer, to review the existing By-laws and Municipal Codes applicable to the Nathan Phillips Square and report to the General Government Committee, by the end of the second quarter of 2025, on the feasibility of assessing the current fee structure for the event bookings on Nathan Phillips Square with proceeds from the fees allocated or other financial instruments to a dedicated reserve to fund capital improvements of Nathan Phillips Square.
text: This report provides an update to members of the General Government Committee on the status of the overall state of amenities of Nathan Phillips Square, the on-going repair program and future planned capital works (both funded and unfunded), the combination of which forms the holistic State-of-Good-Repair program.

The General Government Committee: 1. Requested the General Manager, Economic Development and Culture, in consultation with the Chief Financial Officer, to review the existing By-laws and Municipal Codes applicable to the Nathan Phillips Square and report to the General Government Committee, by the end of the second quarter of 2025, on the feasibility of assessing the current fee structure for the event bookings on Nathan Phillips Square with proceeds from the fees allocated or other financial instruments to a dedicated reserve to fund capital improvements of Nathan Phillips Square.
